title: Bar Drop Yellow Pear 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts White Gummy by Drop recreates the specific, beloved taste of the white gummy bear. It features the familiar confectionery sweetness combined with distinct notes of pineapple on the inhale. The exhale introduces a subtle citrus tang, creating a balanced and accurate candy-inspired vape. This e-liquid uses a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio to enhance the sugary top notes, ensuring the pineapple and citrus nuances taste sharp and distinct. Ideally suited for low-wattage MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices, the nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
